findings: the three crossings form a closed directed cycle (fluid->solid->particles->fluid) and the declared bookings are machine-checked
the contact crossing is reciprocal to round-off (nan relative)
the coupled ledger closes to 6.698e-04 of the initial energy at the production reconstruction degree
the p=1 -> p=2 residual gain in the coupled run is 1.35x, i.e. the campaign's 4x order gate FAILS: the ledger residual is not truncation-limited

the same gain measured on the exchange operator alone is 4.26x and saturates at second order, because one sample per interval is an interval average (a midpoint value), which floors the operator at second order for every p >= 2
degree 3 destabilises the two-way thermal crossing (the cubic extrapolation of the interface temperature amplifies the lattice-scale oscillation of the wall balance); it is reported, not hidden
limitations: verification-scale parameters: conductivity, volumetric heat capacity, diffusivity and carrier viscosity are chosen so that the panel conduction time, the contact duration and the lattice step are all resolvable in one 0.04 s window; they are not a material claim
the carrier flow is prescribed quiescent, so only the energy channel of the DEM->LBM crossing is two-way
thermomechanical two-way coupling (thermoelasticity, friction heat fed back into the panel) is not modelled, so the thermal and mechanical channels are energetically additive
the contact is frictionless and geometrically normal to the panel surface; the panel's deflection under the impact stays below the contact overlap, i.e. the impact is gentle by construction

contact_reciprocity.requirement: the contact contract is reciprocal to round-off (Newton's third law)

drag_transfer_balance.requirement: the reconstructed drag heat delivered to the fluid agrees with the measured particle loss to better than 5 %

flux_continuity.requirement: two independent discretisations of the interface heat flux agree to better than 2 %

interpolation_order_gain.requirement: quadratic interface reconstruction reduces the ledger residual by at least 4x relative to linear reconstruction

negative_control_conservation.requirement: each uncoupled field conserves its own energy to better than 1e-6

reconstruction_operator_order.requirement: the reconstruction operator itself must show the second-order gain (>= 4x) on a smooth signal

total_energy_residual.requirement: three-field runtime ledger closes to better than 1e-3 relative to the initial energy at the production reconstruction degree p=3

vacuity_contact_engaged.requirement: the contact crossing must actually be exercised (overlap > 0)

vacuity_drag_engaged.requirement: the drag crossing must transfer a non-zero amount

vacuity_thermal_engaged.requirement: the thermal crossing must carry a non-zero flux

negative_control.metric: secular drift = |mean(last quarter) - mean(first quarter)| / E0
